executive_assessment.text: Atoll-specific scenarios and NDMA's 2024 incident records add spatial detail, with explicit model and remote-island reporting limitations.

Migrant precarity, inaccessible warnings and conditional migration/cohesion risks differentiate vulnerabilities. School gardening is a reported activity; farm forecasting remains a feasibility discussion.

geographic_notes.text: Source dated 2024-11-28 reports: CMIP6 projects greatest rainfall and flood risk centrally, increases in northern atolls and declines in named southern atolls.
Source dated 2024-11-28 reports: Risk matrix flags climate-induced atoll-to-Malé migration as a social-cohesion, settlement-crowding and housing/WASH risk.
ESCAP's exposure model estimates 47% of Meemu's population and over 30% in Alifu Dhaalu, Haa Alifu, Haa Dhaalu and Kaafu exposed under its greater-than-one-metre sea-level-rise scenarios by 2060.
ESCAP models high-precipitation exposure for agricultural land in Kaafu and on Thoddo/Thoddoo and Kashidhoo, with low-elevation agricultural exposure in Gnaviyani, Seenu, Haa Dhaalu and Raa.
Source dated not stated reports: NDMA recorded 251 mixed-hazard incidents across 20 atolls in 2024 and 1,423 flood-affected households; Kaafu, Seenu and Laamu had the most reported rainwater floods.
Source dated not stated reports: ECRFS reported practical climate-smart gardening training for 88 students and school staff at Ghaazee School in August 2026, with continued technical support planned.
Source dated not stated reports: ECRFS and Maldives Meteorological Service discussed a localized farm-weather pilot for Addu Meedhoo, but still planned to assess feasibility and data needs.

known_gaps.text: Automated machine-screening is not independent source verification. Routine/default app-use approval does not certify claims or sources. 19 of 19 evidence records and 0 of 0 pathways lack claim-level verification in this remediation; review the linked records before relying on them.
No inspected Maldives source explicitly links climate hazards to conflict or violence; no such pathway is asserted.
The full CCDR and CEA PDFs could not be inspected; projection and counterfactual methods are therefore not independently detailed here.
Draft collection pending human source review and approval. IDA eligibility is not an FCV classification.
National and selected local examples do not establish district-level coverage or causal attribution.
The bank contains no completed mediated climate-FCV pathway; this is an evidence gap, not evidence of absence.

No reviewed primary source tied armed conflict or political violence to Maldives climate exposure or documented insecurity preventing a named adaptation activity; absence of evidence in this search is not evidence of no link.
The 2021 CCA's climate-related food-scarcity and transactional-sex pathway is a conditional historical risk statement, not a measured rate or present-day estimate.
The ESCAP report's exposure projections have model, population, land-use and infrastructure-location limitations; some islands are undercounted or unverified.
NDMA's 2024 incident total combines climate and non-climate hazards and its own report identifies remote-island reporting, demographic disaggregation, aid-monitoring and anticipatory-planning gaps.

The large government ECRFS Gender Assessment and Action Plan PDF was not fully accessible through web retrieval; only its official indexed excerpt was inspected and it is not used for claims in this file.
The CCA 2024 original was reported fully inspected by the collector, but the coordinator's publication-page requests timed out; independent reopening of those passages remains an approval check.
Disability-related exclusion is classified as sensitivity, not automatically as violence. The earlier CCA's exploitative-coping pathway is a conditional synthesis, not country-specific incidence.
Routine/default app-use approval granted by Lindsey Jones on 2026-10-27; independent source verification remains incomplete. Lending eligibility is not an FCV classification.
